summary: Verify every licence the stack depends on from its LICENSE file, record it, and set the subprocess rule for GPL tools before any code depends on them.
reuse: docs/research/competitive-landscape-2026-11.md: stack table with licences marked ‡ where unverified

tasks.task: Write docs/licences.md with every dependency's licence verified from its repository LICENSE file.
steps: 1. List every dependency in environment.yml plus Three.js and Plotly.
2. Open each project's LICENSE file on its official repository and record name, version, licence, URL of the LICENSE file and the date checked.
3. Mark GPL tools (CalculiX, gmsh) with the rule 'subprocess only, never imported into distributed code'.
4. Add an 'Excluded' section: FluidX3D (licence forbids commercial use and AI training), TetGen and Palabos (AGPL), JAX-FEM (GPL-3, commercial use needs the author).
5. Write any licence that differs from the research report at the top under 'Corrections to the research'.
verify: prints a row count at least equal to the number of dependencies plus the header rows
tasks.done_when: Every dependency has a verified licence row with a LICENSE URL and date.
do_not: do not copy a licence from the research report without opening the LICENSE file
tasks.stop_and_ask_if: a dependency's licence forbids hosted or commercial use.

acceptance: docs/licences.md lists every dependency with a verified LICENSE URL
GPL subprocess rule and exclusions are written down
risks: Licences change between versions; record the version checked.
